description: This file defines a utility class 'SavingsHelper' used within the savings domain of the Fineract project. It provides methods for determining interest posting periods, calculating interest across multiple periods, and fetching transaction IDs related to interest postings.

classes.name: SavingsHelper
classes.description: A utility service class providing methods for handling interest posting periods and interest calculations related to savings accounts.

methods.name: determineInterestPostingPeriods
methods.description: Calculates a list of interest posting periods based on start date, up to date, posting period type, fiscal year start month, and prior interest posting dates.

methods.name: determineInterestPostingPeriodEndDateFrom
methods.description: Determines the end date for an interest posting period based on the period start date, period type, interest posting up to date, and fiscal year start month.

methods.name: calculateInterestForAllPostingPeriods
methods.description: Delegates calculation of total interest over multiple posting periods to the CompoundInterestHelper.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIds
methods.description: Fetches transaction IDs for interest postings for a given account, with optional pivot date filtering.
